high_level_description: The image is a screenshot from an Instagram post by thecosmologicalway. The post features a visually striking graphic of an atom with electrons depicted as glowing particles orbiting around a central nucleus. The background is dark, with hints of blue and green, giving it a cosmic or scientific feel. The title of the post reads, "We Never Actually Touch Anything," which is attributed to Brian Greene. Below the title, there is a quote that explains the concept: "Grasp a glass and you don't actually touch it.
